tab7_narrative_quant.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.54 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03728-0.03752 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.03800; the first objective pays 1.00R at 0.03698.
